name: door-support-removed
comment: BlockDoor.onNeighborBlockChange without a player: three doors on the stone platform. t=2 removes the stone under the left wooden door (not isBlockNormalCube below: both halves go, the lower half drops the door item, Block.dropBlockAsItem), t=4 removes the upper half of the middle door (the lower half sees no door above, vanishes and drops), t=6 removes the lower half of the iron door by set_block (the upper half sees no door below and vanishes without a drop). block_box every tick, the dropped EntityItems' state every tick.
